what: First run of Plastile in a physical Plasma session (owner-run; not the scripted runbook)
source: the owner's report of the session (2026-10-18), not tool output; no raw logs are committed

environment.note: a laptop, not the three-output reference machine of ENVIRONMENT.md

finding: Plastile worked; the owner twice judged it not working. Two Meta+Shift+Space presses had switched the context master/stack -> BSP -> monocle, where both windows fill the work area, stacked, which looks like no tiling. The command-chosen layout is persisted per context (T27), so it survived a re-login. At the default diagnostics level (warn) the journal showed only five QV4 load warnings (qt.qml.usedbeforedeclared) and no sign of life. An active maximized window suspends tiling (solves with n:0) with no visible signal. A layout reset sent over D-Bus applied to the active window's context, which was another virtual desktop's.

runbookCoverage.P0: partly: a Wayland Plasma session with KWin 6.7.5, Plastile the only tiler (not run through session_check.py)
runbookCoverage.P1: install and a manual smoke test: package and helper installed, 68 shortcuts registered with no conflict, both windows placed (monocle), persistence active across a re-login

followUp: first-run diagnosability: a notice log level shown at warn (started, layout changes), Plasma's OSD on layout changes, layout commands target the visible context, first-run docs (monocle, floating and maximized look like no tiling), the five QV4 warnings removed
